target.title: fix: tighten control ui input validation [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where edge-case Control UI preview inputs and assistant media filenames were accepted more broadly than needed, which could produce unnecessary upstream requests or less predictable download headers.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change tightens shared object-key filtering, validates GitHub preview repository names before any preview fetch, normalizes GitHub avatar URLs to a small deterministic request shape, and sanitizes assistant media filenames before building response headers. The patch keeps the existing Control UI and config merge behavior for valid inputs.

## User Impact

Users should see the same behavior for normal GitHub issue and pull request previews and normal assistant media downloads. Invalid preview targets, unsafe avatar URLs, and unusual media filenames are now handled more conservatively.

## Evidence

AI-assisted change.

Validation:

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/prototype-keys.test.ts src/config/merge-patch.proto-pollution.test.ts src/gateway/control-ui-github-preview.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/control-ui.http.test.ts -t 'sanitizes control characters|caps long'`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/control-ui.http.test.ts -t 'sanitizes control characters|caps long|ill-formed assistant media filename'` with temporary Node v24.15.0 / SQLite 3.51.3 after the Windows-safe test rewrite

Remote proof was attempted first. Blacksmith Testbox was unavailable because the CLI was not present, and direct AWS Crabbox required broker login. I used a local live-server fallback with temporary Node v24.15.0 / SQLite 3.51.3, isolated temporary config/state, auth token redacted, and inherited sensitive environment cleared.

Real setup proof:

- Before ref: `4f86a29c986a7b8d4c037b636f78f4a7d97b8f9c`
- After behavior-fix ref: `344c5497bbc3fef88728da032feae63e363f216a`
- Latest pushed head: `cec20372a779990a4e02aad4520c0c018fc7a6e7`; the proof-relevant delta from the behavior-fix ref to this head is the Windows-safe test rewrite in `src/gateway/control-ui.http.test.ts`

Redacted before/after output summary:

- GitHub preview repository validation: before accepted `.github`, `foo..bar`, `-edge`, `repo.git`, and `repo.atom`; after still accepted `.github`, `foo..bar`, and `-edge`, while rejecting `.`, `..`, `repo.git`, and `repo.atom`.
- GitHub avatars: before kept `https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/58493?v=4&s=64` and fetched/data-inlined an unsafe avatar URL; after normalized the safe avatar to `https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/58493?s=64` and did not fetch or data-inline the unsafe avatar.
- Gateway health/bootstrap: `/ready` returned 200 with `ready=true` and no failing services both before and after; bootstrap returned 200 with a local assistant avatar both before and after.
- Assistant media metadata: allowed media still returned 200 with a media ticket; outside-allowed-folders media still returned 200 with code `outside-allowed-folders`.
- Normal assistant media download: status stayed 200, the expected `Content-Disposition` stayed stable, and the content SHA-256 prefix stayed `0a088704bd1aaa03`.
- CRLF assistant media filename: before returned `attachment; filename="draft__final.pdf"; filename*=UTF-8''draft%0D%0Afinal.pdf`; after returned `attachment; filename="draft__final.pdf"; filename*=UTF-8''draft__final.pdf`.
- Long assistant media filename: header length dropped from 470 to 442 while preserving the `.pdf` suffix.


<!-- exact-head-real-proof:start -->
### Exact-head real behavior proof (2026-07-15)

Contributor-owned local proof at exact PR head `51193173ce363dfa25913428d5d98167c371fb49`. The run used Node v24.15.0, a foreground local Gateway process, isolated temporary OpenClaw home/state/config, token auth with the token redacted, and cleared provider/GitHub credential environment variables. No provider credentials were used.

Gateway proof:

```text
githubPreview invalid repo "..": ok=false error=INVALID_REQUEST
githubPreview invalid repo "repo.git": ok=false error=INVALID_REQUEST
githubPreview invalid repo "repo.atom": ok=false error=INVALID_REQUEST

media get crlf-filename: status=200 disposition="attachment; filename=\"draft__final.pdf\"; filename*=UTF-8''draft__final.pdf" length=17 sha256=418b5298a76c91f4

```

TUI search proof was captured through a real PTY with `script` and uses the actual `SearchableSelectList` component. The fixture proves a result is found via `searchText` even though the visible label/description do not contain the query, and that the selected item preserves the enriched searchable item shape:

```text
Exact-head TUI search proof
head: 51193173ce363dfa25913428d5d98167c371fb49
pty: yes
initial frame:
search: >                                                                               

→ Planning  ordinary recent session
  Release follow-up    recent session without visible issue number
  Gateway hardening    Control UI preview and media headers

typed search: OC-860
filtered frame:
search: > OC-860                                                                        

→ Release follow-up  recent session without visible issue number
selected before enter: value=session-proof label=Release follow-up
enter callback: value=session-proof searchText=preserved
```
<!-- exact-head-real-proof:end -->
